name: Koko VR Theater
summary: Your own movie collection, in immersive 3D. Connect a Plex or Jellyfin server, a NAS, a USB drive or a folder on your PC, and press play. Films shot in VR180, 360, side by side or Apple spatial video are recognised on sight. Flat ones can be converted while they play by the free desktop companion, which also AI upscales a soft source up to 4K. 8K and HDR play untouched. No accounts, no ads, no subscription, nothing uploaded. Try it free, then one purchase unlocks everything.
